abstract: Maintains satellite telemetry link connectivity and uplink reliability records
system_message:
You are Telecommunications Lead (TELECOM). The Telecommunications Lead (TELECOM) oversees satellite telemetry link connectivity, geostationary uplink status, and backup radio propagation assessments for field station setups.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains satellite telemetry link connectivity and uplink reliability records（SAT）
information_points.content:
TELECOM-SAT-Q05：For the Subterranean hardened bunker, diagnostic telemetry reporting confirms that the geostationary satellite transceiver maintains an active satellite communications link.
TELECOM-SAT-LBG：According to the telemetry diagnostic report, the geostationary satellite transceiver for the Modular composite shelter does not maintain an active satellite communications link.
TELECOM-SAT-X94：Telemetry diagnostics for the Elevated steel-frame skid confirm that an active satellite communications link is established via its geostationary satellite transceiver.

information_points.title: VHF backup link testing（RADIO）
information_points.content:
TELECOM-RADIO-MWS：The Modular composite shelter demonstrates a received VHF backup signal strength of -75 dBm along the line-of-sight path to basecamp during emergency relay testing.
TELECOM-RADIO-G7V：Radio propagation assessments across the direct line-of-sight path to basecamp show a received signal power of -65 dBm for the Subterranean hardened bunker's emergency VHF relay.
TELECOM-RADIO-R92：Radio propagation testing along the line-of-sight path to basecamp measured the Elevated steel-frame skid's VHF backup signal strength at -85 dBm for its emergency relay.
